geo.strategyMaximum: Maximum — allow all AI crawlers (best for visibility)
geo.strategyBalanced: Balanced — allow search bots, block training bots
geo.robotsHint: Controls how AI crawlers access your site. Affects ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI.
geo.disallowPathsHint: Comma-separated paths blocked for all bots
geo.orgHint: Used for site-wide JSON-LD structured data. Helps AI understand your brand entity.
geo.apisHint: API keys for the Visibility Monitor and Index Checker. Not required for basic GEO features.

email.storageNote: Keys are stored in {file}. Falls back to {env} env var.

aiPrompts.heading: AI Prompts
aiPrompts.intro: Edit the system prompts used by all AI features. Variables in {braces} are replaced at runtime.

aiDefaults.contentHint: Used for SEO optimization, text rewriting, proofreading, and link fixing. Haiku is fast and affordable for these tasks.
aiDefaults.codeHint: Used for HTML interactives, content generation, and AI agent creation. Sonnet is recommended — best balance of quality and cost.
aiDefaults.premiumHint: Used for brand voice analysis and translation. Opus delivers the highest quality for nuanced creative work.
aiDefaults.chatHint: Used for the full-screen Chat mode. Higher token limits and more tool iterations allow complex multi-step tasks like creating multiple posts with scheduling.
aiDefaults.iterationsHint: Each tool call (search, create, schedule) counts as one iteration. Complex tasks may need 25+.
aiDefaults.warning: Changing models affects AI quality and cost. Higher-tier models produce better results but cost more per request. The built-in defaults are recommended for most use cases.

aiSettings.webSearchHint: Enables the {tool} tool for agents with “Web search” enabled.
aiSettings.storageNote: Keys are stored in {file} in your project directory — not in environment variables.

tools.linkCheckerHint: Automatic link checking across all content. Scheduled runs appear in the Calendar.
tools.linkCheckWebhooksHint: Called in order when a link check completes.
tools.publishingHint: Notified when content is auto-published or expired by the scheduler.
tools.agentsHint: Default webhooks for all agents. Individual agents can override with their own webhooks.
tools.contentLifecycleHint: Notified on every content change — create, update, publish, unpublish, trash, restore, clone.
tools.hmacHint: Generic webhooks include HMAC-SHA256 signature when a secret is set.
tools.deployLifecycleHint: Notified when deploys start, succeed, or fail.
tools.mediaLifecycleHint: Notified when media files are uploaded or deleted.
tools.batchOverwriteHint: When running "Analyze All", how should already-analyzed images be handled?
tools.generateWebpHint: Automatically create optimized WebP variants when images are uploaded
tools.variantWidthsHint: Comma-separated pixel widths. Variants larger than the original are skipped.
tools.webpQualityHint: Higher = better quality, larger files. 80 is recommended.

team.inviteHint: Invite an existing user or a new email address to this site.
team.newEmailHint: New email — will create invitation for new user
team.emailNotConfigured: Email not configured — share the link manually. Set up Resend in Settings → Email.

general.schemaExportGithub: Schema export from GitHub-backed configs is not supported yet.
general.name: Name
general.sidebarLogoHint: Choose which logo to display in the sidebar.
general.siteNameHint: Display name shown in the site switcher and Sites Dashboard.
general.configPathHint: Absolute path to cms.config.ts on the filesystem.
general.contentDirHint: Absolute path to the content folder. Defaults to content/ next to config.
general.previewUrlHint: Base URL of the frontend — used for the Preview button on documents.
general.previewIframeHint: Open preview inside the admin panel instead of a new browser tab.
general.inlineEnableHint: Lets editors click text directly on the live site and save changes there — once connected, it works on every page, no per-document step. Requires the site to consume @broberg/cms-inline-edit.
general.homepageHint: Choose which document is served at {root}. Leave empty to use the default convention (a page with slug {home} or {index}).
general.trashRetentionHint: Days before trashed documents are permanently deleted.
general.curationRetentionHint: Days before approved/published items are removed from the curation queue.
general.schemaEditingHint: Allow editing collection schemas from the Settings → Schema tab.
general.devInspectorHint: Show the developer overlay with component and query info.
general.defaultLanguageHint: The primary language for content on this site.
general.supportedLanguagesHint: Additional languages this site supports. Content can be translated to these languages.
general.urlStrategyHint: How locale prefixes appear in URLs.
general.autoTranslateHint: Automatically translate new and updated content to all configured languages.
general.revalidationHint: When content changes, {brand} sends a signed webhook to your site's revalidation endpoint, triggering on-demand path revalidation. Only needed for production deployments.
general.clickAutoHint: Click Auto to generate from your Preview URL: {url}
general.addSecretHint: Add this secret to your site's {env} as {name}

general.purgeTrashHint: Permanently delete all trashed documents right now, regardless of retention period.
general.cannotBeUndone: This cannot be undone. Are you sure?
general.moveSiteHint: Transfer this site and all its settings to a different organization.
general.moveConfirm: Move {site} to {org}? Settings and content will be preserved.
general.showCloseAll: Show Close All in tab bar
general.showCloseAllHint: Adds a 'Close all' pill next to the new-tab button.
general.schedulerHint: Get notified when the scheduler auto-publishes or unpublishes content. Works with Discord, Slack, or any webhook.
general.webhookUrlHint: Discord, Slack, or any URL that accepts JSON POST
